mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 2.5% annually) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% for 3 consecutive months, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%) and stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals a tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (housing starts above 1,000,000 annualized units), S&P 500 underperforms due to stretched valuations and anticipated policy tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where housing starts exceed 1,000,000 annualized units, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 110.0 for 2 consecutive months, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% MoM) and declining retail sales (RSAFS growth < 0.0% MoM) signals consumer sector weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth falls below 0.5% MoM and RSAFS growth is negative, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals persistent inflation that may prompt immediate Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 1.5% annualized) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
